_: Take 136 (A43): what every installed build reads in a synced catalogue. An install refuses a catalogue that lacks one of these columns, or whose list or record here has another kind (catalogueProblem, take 115), and Pages serves the newest take's catalogue to every install. So this record only grows: a take that adds a column or a list adds it here; none is ever taken out.
